# Economy Recipes
These combinations of materials, when in their respective machines, can create important resources.
Reminder: Chemicals can be present in any container inserted into the machine in addition to other resources.
Many common materials can also contain chemicals. These can be extracted via a reagent grinder.
[color=yellow]"Unfinished" components universally say what components they need to start construction![/color]
# Industrial Planner
An industrial planner can be built at any autolathe or bought at cargo pads. It has a display of the chains for all hand-crafting, such as heavy armor plates.
